rules.name: Present_request_was_declined_or_cancelled
rules.label: Present request was declined or cancelled

formulas.name: Choose_next_status
formulas.expression: If({!choose_current_status}="Approval Requested" && {!Approve_decline_toggle.value}=true, "Ordered", If({!choose_current_status}="Approval Requested" && {!Approve_decline_toggle.value}=false, "Declined", If({!choose_current_status}="Ordered" && {!Shipped_check}=true, "Shipped", If({!Cancelled_checkbox}=true, "Cancelled", If({!choose_current_status}="Shipped" && {!Delivered_check}=true, "Delivered", TEXT({!get_present_in_approval_process.Status__c}))))))

formulas.name: Present_name
formulas.expression: TEXT( DAY( TODAY() ) ) & "/" & TEXT( MONTH( TODAY() ) ) & "/" & TEXT( YEAR( TODAY() ) )+" - "+{!get_related_account.FirstName}+" "+{!get_related_account.LastName}+" "+{!Appreciation_catalogue.firstSelectedRow.Item_Name__c}

formulas.name: user_picker
formulas.expression: CASE({!$UserRole.Name}, "Desk Manger USA", "desk", "Desk Manager Spanish", "desk", "Desk Manager Partnerships and Global Campaigns", "desk", "Desk Manager Israel", "desk", "Desk Manager European", "desk", "Desk Manager English", "desk", "CRM Manager", "financial", "Office Coordinator", "ERO", "Salesforce Adminisrator", "desk", "")
